description: Ground truth for the Partial Early Old-Age Pension Advisor (OVE) scenario (core evaluation tier).

smoke_prompts.prompt: I turn 62 next month and want to explore taking 50% partial early old-age pension (OVE) while continuing my job. My member ID is MEM-101 and my current monthly salary is 4200 euros.
Can I take 25% OVE starting next month? My member ID is MEM-102 and I am a 59-year-old teacher.
I want to compare taking 25% vs 50% OVE. My member ID is MEM-103 and I plan to reduce my work hours to 80% with a salary of 2800 euros per month.
I want to apply for 50% OVE. My member ID is MEM-104.

OVE-001.description: Eligible 50% OVE with full-time salary continuation (Matti Virtanen, MEM-101)
OVE-001.symptom: Member turning 62 wants to take 50% OVE while continuing work at €4,200/mo salary.

OVE-002.description: Under statutory cohort minimum age — OVE denied (Liisa Korhonen, MEM-102)
OVE-002.symptom: 59-year-old teacher asks to start 25% OVE; minimum age for cohort 1966 is 62 years.

OVE-003.description: Multi-scenario comparison (25% vs 50% draw) with 80% work hours (Antti Mäkinen, MEM-103)
OVE-003.symptom: Member asks to compare 25% vs 50% OVE options alongside reduced salary of €2,800/mo.

OVE-004.description: Statutory benefit exclusion — active disability pension conflict (Eeva Koskinen, MEM-104)
OVE-004.symptom: Member currently receiving full disability pension (Kuntoutustuki) requests OVE.
red_herrings: Member meets age requirement (age 63) but is barred by active disability pension.
